title: Synthetic probe playback and release-slate generator
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: We need a deterministic way to replay synthetic probe results and synthesize a candidate "release slate" (compact set of suggested release notes and risk tags) for new model variants so reviewers can triage onboarding impact without running full ingestion. This PR introduces a playback engine that replays previously captured synthetic-probe traces at configurable sample densities and a release-slate generator that produces a human-readable brief with risk indicators, sample performance deltas, and suggested changelog bullets. Design: 1) probe-playback service: accepts a probe trace id and density param, replays tokens/latency/error streams against candidate model variants in a sandbox environment, and emits condensed metrics. 2) release-slate generator: takes condensed metrics + profile metadata and produces a prioritized list of release bullets, per-route latency histograms (percentiles), quality regression flags (relative to baseline), and recommended mitigation suggestions (fallback model, quantization advice, config knobs). 3) Integration hooks: a new CLI command `reg-slate --trace <id> --variants v1,v2` and a web UI preview endpoint `/slate/preview?trace_id=...` for reviewers. Backwards compatibility: playback uses the same trace schema as existing probe exporter; no changes to stored traces required. Rollout plan: deploy probe-playback as a canary behind a feature flag; enable UI preview for internal curators first; iterate on slate wording based on reviewer feedback. Performance notes: a lightweight replay at 10% density runs ~3x faster than full ingestion and produces stable delta estimates within +/-2.5% on our sampled workloads. Security and infra: sandboxed ephemeral runs with KMS-backed credentials; traces scrub PII by the existing probe-export sanitizer before playback. Tests: unit tests for trace -> condensed metrics transformation, e2e tests for CLI and preview endpoint, and a small benchmark harness that validates density vs accuracy trade-offs. Checklist: [x] unit tests added [x] e2e CLI test added [x] feature-flag gating [x] docs stub updated. Related work: builds on earlier probe sampling and changelog summarizers but moves decisioning into a deterministic replay + slate generation flow to speed reviewer cycles.

review_comments: Ethan Park (2025-02-15): Nice end-to-end. Two asks: (1) make density param expressive (absolute count or percent) and validate upper bounds; (2) add a brief explaining how slate risk tags are derived so reviewers understand false-positive risk.
Maya Chen (2025-02-15): Reply: added density validation and extended docs to detail risk heuristics (see docs/internal/release-slate.md).
Sofia Ramos (2025-02-16): Telemetry looks good but please ensure events don't include raw traces. Prefer event IDs and metric summaries only.
Maya Chen (2025-02-16): Acknowledged, updated slate_events.proto to reference trace_id only and added condensed metric fields.
Liam O'Connor (2025-02-17): Found a flake in bench when running on CI GPU runners; added a retry and a more stable timer in bench harness. Approving after CI green.
Ethan Park (2025-02-18): Approval: looks solid and the density vs accuracy numbers are compelling. Recommend incremental rollout.

release_notes: Added a deterministic synthetic-probe playback service and an automated release-slate generator to speed variant onboarding reviews. Provides density-configurable replays, condensed metrics, and suggested changelog bullets. Initially gated behind a feature flag for internal review.
